401921087.headline: Iona vs. UMBC prediction
paragraphs: Iona visits UMBC (2-3) at Chesapeake Employers Insurance Arena in Baltimore Monday at 6 PM ET on ESPN+.
Our model calls it a toss-up. The betting market has Iona favored by 2.5 with a total of 145.5. The model leans UMBC +2.5 and Under 145.5.
Players to watch: Riley Jacobs of UMBC, 8.9 points a game; Carlos Varela of UMBC, 4.8 points a game; Jovan Ristic of UMBC, 4.6 points a game.
UMBC is on one day of rest.
